messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@veritylabs.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lina.ortiz@veritylabs.com
Date: Mon, 03 Mar 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation - next steps?

Hi Chloe —

We hit the six-month mark with Redwood next week and I want to start the renewal/expansion conversation. We're pleased with latency improvements and the savings we've seen with the new batch settings, but internal leadership needs a short mutual plan and QBR to lock next year's budget.

High level:
- Current term ends 2025-06-30
- Usage is trending +26% QoQ; we expect another ~20% uptick if we enable the new embeddings pipeline
- Procurement wants an outline of timelines, who signs off, and a rough SOW/commitment window

Can we get a kickoff thread with the Redwood folks who'd own the operational/contract side and a couple of candidate QBR weeks? Lina in procurement (cc'd) will coordinate PO timeline.

Thanks —
Jamie Park
Head of ML Platforms, Verity Labs
jamie.park@veritylabs.com

[attachment: verity_usage_q4_2024.pdf]

Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, david_kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Mar 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual success plan & QBR slotting

Hi Jamie — thanks for kicking this off and for the usage summary. Great to hear latency and cost wins are visible.

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) Mutual Success Plan (MSP) draft — we'll use the attached renewal-playbook-template and populate with capacity/tiers, proposed term options (12/24/36), and a recommended commit band tied to expected throughput. Owner: me (Chloe) and Grace (CS) to produce the initial draft by 3/10.
2) Technical runway review — David will run a quick service-readout to verify the embeddings pipeline impact and any scaling risks. Request: could you share expected peak TPS and any new model variants planned?
3) Procurement/Legal touchpoints — Ben will support with commercial language and DocuSign workflow; Lina, can you share your procurement window (target PO date)?
4) QBR dates — please pick from the poll below. We can do a 60–75 min QBR with exec readout + ops runbook.

Calendar poll (candidate weeks): https://calendar.poll/redwood-verity-qbr-2025
Attachment: renewal-playbook-template.xlsx (blank MSP template).

If the above works I'll create a tentative agenda and a one-pager for leadership.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
T: +1 415 555 0147

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@veritylabs.com>

Cc: lina.ortiz@veritylabs.com
Date: Tue, 04 Mar 2025 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual success plan & QBR slotting

Thanks Chloe — that sounds good. Quick answers:
- Procurement window: our target PO date is 2025-05-15 (we need signed terms and paperwork by 05/10 latest)
- Expected uplift: enabling the embeddings pipeline adds about 18–22% in token throughput, but peak TPS may rise ~35% during nightly ingestion windows.
- Decision owners: myself (Head of ML Platforms), Lina (Procurement), and our Head of Security (name: Aaron Cho; email: aaron.cho@veritylabs.com) — Aaron will need the SOC2 evidence and data-retention commitments.

I'll fill the poll this afternoon. For the MSP, 3/10 works for an initial draft. We can attach the usage PDF I sent to the MSP.

One ask: can Redwood flag any minimum-term discounts vs month-to-month over 12/24/36 so leadership can weigh options?

Cheers,
Jamie

Hi all — looping in a tentative QBR agenda and operational checklist to make the session efficient.

Proposed QBR agenda (60–75 minutes):
- 5 min: Introductions & goals for the quarter (executive sponsor)
- 20 min: Usage & cost readout (Chloe + Jamie)
- 20 min: Tech/ops review — embeddings rollout impact, prefix caching, and scaling plan (David)
- 10 min: Commercial options and recommended commit (Ben + Chloe)
- 10 min: Next steps and action owners (Grace)

Operational checklist before QBR:
- Verity to share peak TPS window and expected new model variants (Jamie) — due 3/10
- Ben to prepare term/discount matrix and example commitment bands — due 3/12
- David to confirm autoscaling safety net and any migration notes — due 3/12
- Security evidence: Aaron Cho to receive SOC2 summary and data-retention excerpt — we'll send a link by 3/09

Suggested QBR weeks (I pulled the top picks from the calendar poll):
- Week of 3/24 (preferred by leadership)
- Week of 4/7 (backup)

Jamie — if those weeks look bad, tell us what works and we'll lock a slot. I'll also create the one-pager and MSP skeleton after Chloe pushes the initial draft.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

- Procurement: we can meet the 05/10 paperwork deadline if terms and cost matrix are in place by 04/30. Lina will manage PO routing.

- QBR: week of 3/24 works best — let's lock 3/25 at 11:00am PT. I'll accept the calendar invite once you send it.

Next steps from Verity: Lina to share PO routing and target signers by 3/14; Aaron to look for SOC2 excerpt by 3/09 (he's on this thread now).
